name: Robot 64 + Plus (PLAYDB!)
desc:
This game features EmK530's PlayDB functionality. You can play levels made by other people and publish your own!
A Robot 64 mod with new moves, animations, and some small visual changes.
7 BONUS icecreams PER LEVEL! 204 icecreams total to collect.
Credit to EmK530 for the PlayDB feature, SkyFear for the RBX Char functionality and Sonickirb for multiplayer RBX Char!
Work in Progress
